max_age_provenance: CMIS current-price evidence contract: a candidate observation older than one minute at the post-read CMIS observation clock is not current. This is an operator governance bound selected independently of the observed Oracle V2 slot ages and independently of the relay loop cadence.
future_skew_provenance: CMIS clock-reference contract: allow at most five seconds of positive source-clock skew relative to the post-read CMIS UTC clock; larger future offsets fail closed. This is an operator governance bound, not derived from observed Oracle V2 slot ages.
minimum_eligible_slots_provenance: Oracle V2 stores five same-system relay slots per asset. Requiring three eligible slots establishes a strict majority quorum while preserving that relay redundancy is not independent market-source evidence.
